content: #3 The explanation is that when you view a page through a link with ‘Vanilla’ in it then the system doesn’t know that you are logged on (because the cookies aren’t sent). That particular discussion is in ‘The Cave’ which is not viewable if you aren’t logged on. So the system thinks you are trying to see something you aren’t allowed to and produces an error. Unfortunately, it produces an actual error in the code rather than a user error. I should fix this …
